headline: Iranian Floating Oil Storage Empties Under Tightened US Naval Blockade
summary: Iran's floating crude oil reserves have run dry under a tightening US naval blockade, with Kpler data showing depleted offshore storage, signaling further constriction of global oil supplies.
why: Iran is a major OPEC oil producer, and disruptions or blockades affecting its crude exports directly impact global supply balances and international energy prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Exhaustion of Iranian floating storage tightens global crude supplies and fuels supply-shortage fears.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: Exhaustion of floating oil storage restricts crude export revenue amid the naval blockade.

why_moved: Crude oil markets face upward supply pressure as Iranian floating reserves are drained and shipments to China stall under US maritime enforcement.
